paragraph: In December 2025 hospital directors said [Angola's hospitals have no integrated information system and share no patient data](<https://focosaude.ao/falta-de-uniformizacao-do-sistema-informatico-de-saude-dificulta-atendimento-e-coloca-vidas-em-risco/>). In the last twelve months, [the Secretary of State for Health said in February 2026 that Angola is making the ReDIV and IOTA systems interoperable with DHIS2](<https://angop.ao/noticias/saude/angola-reafirma-compromisso-com-a-inovacao-digital-no-sistema-de-saude/>). [After a March 2026 mission, the ministry, WHO, HISP UiO and Saudigitus agreed to improve DHIS2's link with the eLMIS](<https://dhis2.org/pt-pt/angola-to-partner-with-hisp-uio-and-who/>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use.

[In June 2026 OpenFn said its workflows automatically exchange HIV programme data between SIDAInfo, IBIPIMO and DHIS2, on a server the health ministry manages](<https://www.openfn.org/spotlight/automating-national-hiv-health-information-exchange-in-burundi>). In the last twelve months, the position changed. In April 2026 [the ministry said DHIS2, SIDAInfo and OpenClinic did not really communicate, causing duplication](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1304-137484-sante-le-burundi-veut-mettre-en-place-un-systeme-d-information-interoperable>), and by June 2026 OpenFn reported three systems exchanging data in production. No source found since October 2023 says patient records are linked through the national ID or a national health identifier. Mature would need patient records linked across systems through the national ID or a national unique health identifier.

In September 2025 Living Goods and partners said [community health worker data are not linked to the national DHIS2](<https://africafrontlinefirst.org/2025/09/29/burkina-faso-is-scaling-up-digital-community-health-systems-through-a-national-roadmap/>). [The ministry drew up a roadmap with Africa CDC, Living Goods and UNICEF to give that link priority](<https://africafrontlinefirst.org/2025/09/29/burkina-faso-is-scaling-up-digital-community-health-systems-through-a-national-roadmap/>). [It still had to be finalised, approved and funded](<https://africafrontlinefirst.org/2025/09/29/burkina-faso-is-scaling-up-digital-community-health-systems-through-a-national-roadmap/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[In March 2026 the health ministry said the Health Information Exchange is being implemented](<https://www.botswanaspeaks.gov.bw/media/COMMITTEE%20OF%20SUPPPLY%20SPEECHES/HEALTH-Committee%20of%20Supply%20Speech%20-%20FINAL%2004-03-2026%20Vol%20I.pdf>). In November 2025 a minister told Parliament that [four patient and data systems are active but not linked across facilities](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89169>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, [the World Bank approved US$13.1 million to link the electronic record, disease surveillance and registries to the exchange](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099541410302526068/pdf/IDU-b74a99ca-88c5-43e8-aba0-34a34d67e29f.pdf>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use.

HISP Rwanda said in March 2026 that [the e-SENI hospital record system sends its clinical data automatically to the national health information systems](<https://hisprwanda.org/hisp-emr-digitizing-hospital-care-in-the-central-african-republic/>). [The data go into platforms built on DHIS2](<https://hisprwanda.org/hisp-emr-digitizing-hospital-care-in-the-central-african-republic/>). In the last twelve months, that account is the only exchange found, and no earlier dated position has been found. No source found says three or more health systems exchange data. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

In September 2025 mHealth Africa said [its community platform sends data to the national DHIS2, SIGSANTE, automatically](<https://www.mhealth-africa.org/en/actualites/mhealth-et-dhis2-vers-une-interoperabilite-renforcee-en-cote-divoire/>). [In June 2023 the surveillance tools DHIS2, MAGPI and SORMAS were found not to exchange data with each other](<https://publichealth.jmir.org/2024/1/e56275>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [the health ministry said it is setting up a national platform for its health information systems to exchange data](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0510-59476-nigeria-builds-national-digital-health-architecture-to-connect-fragmented-systems>). No source found since November 2023 says three or more health systems exchange data. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national exchange in service.

[The health ministry said in November 2026 that a national interoperability platform is in use](<https://scores2000.info/2026/11/sante-numerique-le-cameroun-accelere-l-interconnexion-de-ses-systemes-d-information-sanitaires.html>). [It links the enrolment and billing systems of universal health coverage](<https://scores2000.info/2026/11/sante-numerique-le-cameroun-accelere-l-interconnexion-de-ses-systemes-d-information-sanitaires.html>). In the last twelve months, that platform is the only exchange found, and no earlier dated position has been found. [The ministry said at a workshop of 27 to 31 October 2026 that not all systems are yet connected to the platform](<https://scores2000.info/2026/11/sante-numerique-le-cameroun-accelere-l-interconnexion-de-ses-systemes-d-information-sanitaires.html>). No source found since October 2023 says three or more health systems exchange data. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

[In June 2026 ANICNS, under the health ministry, called for expressions of interest in a national health data centre](<https://www.congoquotidien.com/2026/06/16/actualite-rdc-data-center-sante-rdc/>). [The centre is to gather national health data and link existing systems](<https://www.congoquotidien.com/2026/06/16/actualite-rdc-data-center-sante-rdc/>). [The call closed on 12 July 2026](<https://www.congoquotidien.com/2026/06/16/actualite-rdc-data-center-sante-rdc/>). In the last twelve months, that call is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

On 27 October 2026 the health ministry's statistics directorate [said other applications are integrated into DHIS2 or work with it](<https://www.lagazettedescomores.com/sant%C3%A9/sant%C3%A9-et-num%C3%A9rique-onze-projets-pour-acc%C3%A9l%C3%A9rer-la-transformation-du-syst%C3%A8me-sanitaire-.html>). It named the electronic vaccination register and the system for managing medicines and supplies. In the last twelve months, that statement is the only position found, and no earlier dated position has been found. The same meeting named interoperability of tools among the main challenges still ahead. No source says whether the vaccination register and the medicines system are modules of DHIS2 or separate systems. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service.

[In April 2026 the health ministry sought a consultancy for a laboratory system for 20 public laboratories](<https://ugpe.gov.cv/uploads/TDR_OP_3_28_04_2026_vf_1_f29bd63f85.pdf>). [It must link with DHIS2, existing laboratory systems, the health information system and surveillance](<https://ugpe.gov.cv/uploads/TDR_OP_3_28_04_2026_vf_1_f29bd63f85.pdf>). In December 2025 [the health minister said a unique patient code, digital records and e-prescriptions are being advanced](<https://www.inforpress.cv/en/article-6732>). In the last twelve months, no earlier dated position has been found for either plan. No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[On 11 April 2026 the health minister said a digital platform for following patients' medical records had recently been set up](<https://www.aps.dz/fr/algerie/sante-et-environnement/mnun8thn-achevement-de-la-mise-en-place-d-une-plateforme-numerique-de-suivi-a-distance-des-dossiers-medicaux-des-patients>). [It is meant to speed the exchange of information between health structures across the country](<https://www.aps.dz/fr/algerie/sante-et-environnement/mnun8thn-achevement-de-la-mise-en-place-d-une-plateforme-numerique-de-suivi-a-distance-des-dossiers-medicaux-des-patients>). [The minister gave no figures and named no connected structures](<https://www.aps.dz/fr/algerie/sante-et-environnement/mnun8thn-achevement-de-la-mise-en-place-d-une-plateforme-numerique-de-suivi-a-distance-des-dossiers-medicaux-des-patients>). In the last twelve months, that statement is the only position found, and no earlier dated position has been found. No source found names two health systems exchanging data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

In June 2025 [the ministry signed with eHealth to operate the National Digital Health System](<https://www.ehealth.com.eg/ministry-of-health-and-ehealth-collaborate-to-operate-the-national-digital-health-system/>). In the last twelve months, [on 30 September 2026 the deputy health minister met Vodafone, the communications ministry and the insurance authority on digital integration](<https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=30092026&id=f9a15835-24e7-4d30-a2d6-02c1f70eb399>), and the ministry stressed activating the health information exchange. [In September 2026 it proposed a smart healthcare platform to share patient histories between facilities](<https://www.dailynewsegypt.com/2026/09/14/egypt-plans-unified-digital-platform-to-link-patient-records-across-health-facilities/>). No source found names two health systems exchanging data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use.

[In March 2026 DIAL reported that health stakeholders chose a multi-tenant medical record pilot as the next step to test interoperability](<https://dial.global/ethiopias-approach-to-use-cases/>). [No launch date was given](<https://dial.global/ethiopias-approach-to-use-cases/>). In the last twelve months, that pilot is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. [DIAL says Ethiopia's digital health sector has more than 70 siloed platforms](<https://dial.global/ethiopias-approach-to-use-cases/>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

No stage is set. Gabon began rolling out the DHIS2 Tracker from 2026, and it is part of [the national DHIS2](<https://gabonmediatime.com/sante-numerique-le-gabon-premier-pays-dafrique-francophone-a-deployer-le-dhis2-tracker/>). No source found names two separate health systems exchanging data. No change in exchange between separate systems has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need an exchange between health systems that is contracted, being built or piloted, or a health information exchange being set up.

[In November 2024 the health ministry's head of research said the Ghana Health Information Exchange sought to link systems for real-time data sharing](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/11/ministry-of-health-assures-nationwide-health-data-interoperability/>). [He named limited interoperability as the main obstacle](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/11/ministry-of-health-assures-nationwide-health-data-interoperability/>). No change to the exchange has been found in the last twelve months. [In August 2026 the Ghana Health Service launched an emergency operations centre with integrated dashboards](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/08/ghs-launches-strategic-pheoc-documents-to-strengthen-public-health-emergency-response/>). No source found says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[A health ministry mission in August 2026 found OpenClinic in five facilities of Mamou and Dalaba](<https://lepandaguinee.com/2026/08/26/guinee-a-mamou-et-dalaba-le-pari-de-la-reforme-sanitaire-prend-une-nouvelle-dimension/>). [The hospital system offers interoperability with the national DHIS2](<https://lepandaguinee.com/2026/08/26/guinee-a-mamou-et-dalaba-le-pari-de-la-reforme-sanitaire-prend-une-nouvelle-dimension/>). [Paper reporting to the national health information system continues alongside it](<https://lepandaguinee.com/2026/08/26/guinee-a-mamou-et-dalaba-le-pari-de-la-reforme-sanitaire-prend-une-nouvelle-dimension/>). In the last twelve months, in November 2025, [a Conakry workshop trained staff on interoperability and mapped the sector's digital tools](<https://guineenews.org/2025/11/27/interoperabilite-tenue-dun-atelier-cle-pour-la-modernisation-du-systeme-dinformation-sanitaire-en-guinee>). No source found says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[In July 2026 the health and education ministries signed a memorandum to link the HMIS with the education system](<https://gambiana.com/mobse-and-health-ministry-sign-deal-to-link-education-and-health-data-systems/>). [A joint working group was set up](<https://gambiana.com/mobse-and-health-ministry-sign-deal-to-link-education-and-health-data-systems/>). In the last twelve months, that memorandum followed a World Bank report of November 2025 that [counted none of four systems interoperable, the health insurance system among them](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099112925154035950/pdf/P179233-79b99711-b6ff-4c20-b5cb-2d5ef7838226.pdf>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

In August 2026 Zenysis said [the national data platform NIA integrates data from several DHIS2 instances](<https://www.zenysis.com/news/guinea-bissau-ministry-of-public-health-and-zenysis-sign-five-year-memorandum-of-understanding-to-advance-national-health-intelligence-and-responsible-ai>). [It also draws on programme systems and partner datasets](<https://www.zenysis.com/news/guinea-bissau-ministry-of-public-health-and-zenysis-sign-five-year-memorandum-of-understanding-to-advance-national-health-intelligence-and-responsible-ai>). In the last twelve months, that account is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. The only account of NIA found is the vendor's, given when [Zenysis and the ministry signed a five-year memorandum in August 2026](<https://www.zenysis.com/news/guinea-bissau-ministry-of-public-health-and-zenysis-sign-five-year-memorandum-of-understanding-to-advance-national-health-intelligence-and-responsible-ai>). Mature would need patient records linked across systems through the national ID or a national unique health identifier.

[In August 2025 the ministry launched a health information exchange for hospitals, counties and national systems](<https://www.health.go.ke/ministry-health-launches-biometric-health-identification-advances-digital-health-transformation>). The ministry said in January 2025 that [the national exchange, with its client, provider and facility registries, was fully deployed by December 2024](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2025-01-22-moh-182-million-kenyans-registered-under-sha>). [A legal notice in force from 11 April 2025 sets up a service bus routing messages between certified health systems](<https://new.kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/ln/2025/77/eng@2025-04-11>). No change to the exchange has been found in the last twelve months. [In August 2026 the Cabinet Secretary said a Safaricom consortium is building the national system for insurance registration and claims](<https://citizen.digital/article/health-cs-duale-dismisses-claims-ksh12b-sha-funds-paid-to-private-firm-n387700>). No source found says patient records are linked by the national ID or the biometric health identifier. Mature would need patient records linked across systems through the national ID or a national unique health identifier.

[In March 2026 Liberia was one of four pilot countries for automated transfer of routine data from national DHIS2 systems](<https://atlanticinfos.tg/2026/03/08/benin-waho-initie-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-partage-automatise-des-donnees-de-sante-de-routine-phase-1/>). [The West African Health Organisation runs the pilot](<https://atlanticinfos.tg/2026/03/08/benin-waho-initie-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-partage-automatise-des-donnees-de-sante-de-routine-phase-1/>). [Its first phase is to design and test a secure architecture for the transfer](<https://atlanticinfos.tg/2026/03/08/benin-waho-initie-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-partage-automatise-des-donnees-de-sante-de-routine-phase-1/>). In the last twelve months, that pilot is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. No source found says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

No stage is set. The health ministry's health information centre page names [DHIS2](<https://moh.gov.ly/pages/centers-offices/health-info-center>). No source found names two health systems exchanging data. The medicines tracking system activated in 2025 is one system used by several bodies. No change in exchange between separate systems has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need an exchange between health systems that is contracted, being built or piloted, or a health information exchange being set up.

[A 2025 study says the health ministry's eRegister medical record is integrated with the national DHIS2](<https://doi.org/10.1186/s12911-025-02858-3>). [The eRegister has been in use since 2018](<https://doi.org/10.1186/s12911-025-02858-3>). [WHO said Lesotho advanced interoperability across its HMIS, workforce, logistics and surveillance platforms in 2025](<https://www.afro.who.int/sites/default/files/2026-04/WHO%20LESOTHO%202025%20ANNUAL%20REPORT%20.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 FHI 360 sought a consultant to link its LEAD, Infolink and Tracker systems with the national DHIS2](<https://selibeng.com/epic-lesotho-consultancy-digital-health-and-data-analytics/>). No source found says three or more health systems exchange data. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

An analyst's piece in TelQuel of 22 October 2026 says [Bill 52-26 provides for a shared medical record, health identifiers and interoperability between health systems](<https://telquel.ma/2026/10/22/bill-52-26-digitizing-healthcare-but-why_2010995>). [It says the electronic treatment form is being rolled out with the national social security fund, the CNSS](<https://telquel.ma/2026/10/22/bill-52-26-digitizing-healthcare-but-why_2010995>). [The piece says the form is to be integrated with the shared medical record](<https://telquel.ma/2026/10/22/bill-52-26-digitizing-healthcare-but-why_2010995>). In the last twelve months, that piece is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. No source found names two health systems exchanging data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[In October 2025 the health-financing platform mTOMADY announced it is now interoperable with DHIS2](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/mtomady_digitalhealth-interoperability-dhis2-activity-7381257757754150912-s2DE>). [The announcement gave no data flows or scope](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/mtomady_digitalhealth-interoperability-dhis2-activity-7381257757754150912-s2DE>). No change to that link has been found in the last twelve months. [In 2026 a DHIS2 Tracker pilot for vaccination ran in 20 basic health centres and 54 private vaccination sites](<https://www.afro.who.int/sites/default/files/2026-08/Revue%20trimestrielle%20Version%20avril%20juin%202026%20OMS%20Madagascar.pdf>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[In July 2025 a deputy director of the health ministry said DHIS2 and DISC-Mali had been made interoperable](<https://www.musohealth.org/post/towards-an-integrated-and-efficient-health-information-ecosystem>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [the pharmacy directorate restored automatic data transfer between DHIS2 and the OSPSANTE logistics system](<https://www.dirpharma.ml/index.php/fr/blog/interoperabilite-dhis2-ospsante-atelier-koulikoro-2026>). [ANTIM says the SNISI system brings the tools of several NGO-funded collection systems into one database](<https://snisi.sante.gov.ml/about>). No source found says three or more separate health systems exchange data through one exchange. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

[C-Saude reported in October 2025 that the DISA laboratory system sends viral load results automatically to the SESP patient tracking system](<https://csaude.org.mz/2025/10/29/connecting-health-information-systems-improving-hiv-care/>). [The link covers more than 500 facilities in every province](<https://csaude.org.mz/2025/10/29/connecting-health-information-systems-improving-hiv-care/>). [In July 2024 Mozambique began linking the hospital births module to civil registration through OpenHIM](<https://www.jembi.org/case-study/mozambique>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says three or more health systems exchange data in one exchange. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

[In March 2026 World Bank experts proposed an integrated platform for hospitals, health centres and health posts](<https://saharamedias.net/254033>). [The health minister confirmed that work would begin](<https://saharamedias.net/254033>). [A joint technical committee is to follow it](<https://saharamedias.net/254033>). In the last twelve months, that proposal is the only change found, and no earlier dated position has been found. [In July 2026 WHO supported an electronic consultation register in Timbédra and Amourj districts](<https://www.afro.who.int/fr/countries/mauritania/news/mauritanie-des-donnees-fiables-pour-mieux-repondre-aux-epidemies-dans-le-hod-el-charghi-et-hod-el>). No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[UNDP says Mauritius launched the Rs 600 million 'One Patient, One Record' project on 27 January 2024](<https://www.undp.org/mauritius-seychelles/news/undp-supports-launch-one-patient-one-record-ehealth-project-enhanced-public-healthcare>). [It stresses exchange of health information among providers](<https://www.undp.org/mauritius-seychelles/news/undp-supports-launch-one-patient-one-record-ehealth-project-enhanced-public-healthcare>). [First results were due at Jawaharlal Nehru Hospital from August 2024](<https://www.undp.org/mauritius-seychelles/news/undp-supports-launch-one-patient-one-record-ehealth-project-enhanced-public-healthcare>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the public sector aimed for full e-Health coverage by 2027](<https://www.lemauricien.com/actualites/societe/secteur-public-13-ans-apres-projet-e-health-vers-une-couverture-complete-dici-a-fin-2027/712419/>), and no first results have been found. No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

[In April 2026 DHIS2 said linking the iCHIS community platform's NCD module with the MaHIS medical record is being finalised](<https://dhis2.org/fighting-ncds-in-malawi-and-sri-lanka-with-the-diabetes-compass-project/>). [It is the last step before full field use](<https://dhis2.org/fighting-ncds-in-malawi-and-sri-lanka-with-the-diabetes-compass-project/>). In the last twelve months, [a ministry project running from December 2025 to March 2027 is linking the DHIS2 health system and the One Health surveillance platform with EWARS](<https://dhis2.org/malawi-project-to-strengthen-surveillance-climate-sensitive-diseases/>). No earlier dated position has been found for either link. No source found since November 2023 says two health systems exchange data in routine use. Establishing would need two or more health systems exchanging data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or a supply-chain system.

A 2025 account by UCSF's NAMTAC programme says [the PTracker system automatically submits aggregated data to DHIS2 and the national data warehouse](<https://informaticshub.ucsf.edu/node/116>). The same account says [the warehouse combines data from Quantum EPMS, DHIS2 and DHIS2 Tracker, and an OpenHIM-based exchange was developed](<https://informaticshub.ucsf.edu/node/116>). In the last twelve months, [in March 2026 health minister Esperance Luvindao said Namibia's health information systems remain fragmented](<https://www.we.com.na/health-we/fragmented-systems-still-hinder-healthcare-as-namibia-pushes-digital-remodel-nmh008500-4-9782>). No source found settles whether exchange reaches across the health system. Operating would need three or more health systems exchanging data, or a national health information exchange in service that no source shows linking fewer than three.

[At a workshop on 8 July 2026 the national interoperability layer was shown working with several systems](<https://anp.ne/sante-numerique-ouverture-de-latelier-de-validation-de-la-feuille-de-route-budgetisee-du-schema-directeur-national-de-la-e-sante-2025-2029/>). [In August 2026 the Data.FI project said the layer, built on OpenFn, links three health platforms to the national DHIS2 system](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/data-fi-project_niger-dhis2-interoperability-activity-7493677620434288642-RoBC>). In the last twelve months, the layer went from installation to use with four systems.
